title: Repute Pay
tagline: WIP: An escrow payment system where contractors get paid from vetted clients.
description: WIP: A platform where a human-verified client can hire contractors for work. Contractors can be assured payment by vetting their clients based on reputation from payment history for past work. A client who has consistently paid for completed work, is the one that contractors can trust.
how_its_made: WIP: This project makes use of (or at least plan to) use World ID to verify client uniqueness. Ensuring that misbehaved clients will be slashed and cannot re-register themselves with a different wallet. This project makes use of ENS subname resolvers to keep records of client ratings and reputation. Clients must be assigned with a subname upon registration. Upon job completion, the platform automatically updates the client's ENS records and standing based on the payment outcome.
auto_summary: A Solidity contract system for freelancer job escrow and client staking that includes World ID-based client registration verification.
